description: Coastal Community Resilience in Maine is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Adaptation Knowledge Exchange (CAKE); Maine Sea Grant. As part of its mission, Maine Sea Grant educates communities on important marine and coastal issues. Coverage: Orono, ME (2007). The toolkit gives Orono, ME as the location, 2007 as the year and 6 years as the duration. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
